procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：水壩地震動力分析
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Seismic dynamic analysis of dams
guides.concept: 本課把混凝土水壩的線性模態示意與土石壩孔壓機制分開，從質量、剛度、阻尼及地震輸入逐步走向水庫互制、接縫與數值收斂。十個單元均有原創計算與明確邊界，要求學徒追蹤同時刻、同座標和相同物理定義，不以單一週期或峰值吻合宣告整壩耐震合格。
guides.conceptEn: The course separates linear concrete-dam modal illustrations from embankment pore-pressure mechanisms. It moves through mass, stiffness, damping and forcing to reservoir interaction, joints and numerical convergence. Ten original calculations require consistent time, coordinates and physical definitions; matching one period or peak never establishes complete seismic adequacy.
procedure: 水壩地震反應不是把整座重量直接乘一個係數，首先要理解材料剛度、基礎與水庫如何形成振動模態。單自由度模型只代表已選定的廣義座標，其質量和剛度必須成對校準；不同模態參與程度不同，第一週期吻合也不能證明全部壩體應力分布正確。 假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。
慣性力跟質量及相應的絕對加速度有關，但地表峰值、基岩輸入與結構反應不是同一數據。等效靜力只提供量級，不能代替時變相位與變形計算；三方向輸入還要保持坐標一致，避免把不同時刻峰值任意拼成實際不存在的受力狀態。 假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。
阻尼比是相對臨界阻尼的比例，實體耗能可包含材料、接縫和基礎輻射，不應任意重複加入。線性黏滯模型便於分析但不能代表所有開裂摩擦機制，且校準模態與頻率範圍必須明示；增加阻尼使數值變小不等於取得可靠設計。 假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。
共振概念可用持續正弦力說明，但地震是有限時間且頻率不斷改變的訊號，兩者反應不能混用。線性振子的穩態放大取決於頻率比及阻尼，建立穩態需要時間；脈衝、非線性接縫和頻率漂移可能使真正峰值與簡式大不相同。 假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。
擬加速度反應譜與位移譜在同一線性振子和阻尼下可由角頻率換算，但擬加速度不是任意量測絕對加速度峰值。譜值忽略不同模態峰值發生時間，合成規則需另外選擇；先確認譜的定義與單位，才有資格比較位移和接縫需求。 假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。
質量與剛度比例阻尼可在兩個指定模態匹配目標，但頻帶之外不會維持同一比例。低頻受質量項控制、高頻受剛度項控制，網格細化加入高頻模態可能造成過度衰減；應檢查整段頻率曲線，不能只驗算兩個校準點就認為全部動力都一致。 假設兩模態1與3Hz均ζ=0.05，C=αM+βK得α=0.47124s⁻¹、β=0.0039789s；在2Hz時ζ=0.04375。
水庫動壓可能與壩體運動耦合，簡化附加質量僅在已指定形狀與頻率條件下代表某種等效作用。不能把整個水庫重量直接加到壩上，亦不能忽略可壓縮性、邊界吸收或水位改變；本單元固定剛度，只檢查一個假設附加量如何改變週期。 假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。
接縫張開由相鄰部位同一時刻的相對位移決定，而不是兩個獨立最大值相減或平方和。坐標方向和局部法向需先定義，剛體平移應在相減時消除；縫面接觸、止水材料與剪切交互作用則需另建模型，位移量本身不代表水密性。 假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。
動力積分步長要解析關心的短週期，但每週期點數只是起點，不是收斂證明。輸入記錄取樣、內插方法、積分演算法和非線性接觸都可能施加更嚴限制；縮小步長後應比較峰值、相位及能量，而不是只確認程式沒有發散或報錯。 假設最短關注週期0.20s、積分步長0.005s，點數T/Δt=40；不能由此保證輸入頻寬或接觸反應已解析。
土石壩可能發生循環孔壓增加及強度改變，這與混凝土線彈性振子是不同機制。有效應力下降需以相同應力路徑和時間的資料計算，孔壓比接近某值也不能單獨宣告整座壩已液化；殘餘強度、震後排水與永久變形仍需專門材料和穩定分析。 假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。
procedureEn: Dam response begins with how stiffness, foundation and reservoir interactions form vibration modes rather than multiplying total weight by one coefficient. A single degree of freedom represents a chosen generalized coordinate whose mass and stiffness must be calibrated together. Matching the first period does not establish the correctness of higher modes or the complete spatial stress distribution. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.

Inertia depends on mass and its corresponding absolute acceleration, but surface peak, bedrock input and structural response are different quantities. Equivalent static force gives a scale rather than temporal phase or deformation. Three-component inputs also require consistent coordinates, and unrelated peaks must not be assembled into a force state that never occurred in the actual time history. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA.

Damping ratio is relative to critical damping, while physical dissipation can include material, joints and radiation into the foundation. These effects must not be counted twice. Linear viscous damping is convenient but does not represent every cracking or friction mechanism, and calibration needs a specified modal and frequency range rather than an arbitrary value chosen to reduce response. Assume m=50000000kg,k=2000000000N/m and ζ=0.05. c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m, representing linear viscous damping only.

Sustained sinusoidal force illustrates resonance, but earthquakes have finite duration and changing frequency content. Their responses are not interchangeable. Steady harmonic amplification depends on frequency ratio and damping and takes time to develop. Pulses, nonlinear joints and frequency shifts can make actual peaks substantially different from the simplified forced-oscillator value even when its natural period is known. Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.

Pseudo-spectral acceleration and spectral displacement convert through angular frequency for the same linear oscillator and damping. Pseudo-acceleration is not an arbitrary measured absolute-acceleration peak. Spectra also omit the timing of different modal maxima, requiring separate combination rules. Definitions and units must therefore be checked before comparing converted displacement with joint or deformation demands. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.

Mass- and stiffness-proportional damping can match a target at two selected modes but does not maintain that ratio outside them. The mass term dominates low frequency and stiffness term high frequency, so refinement can add excessively damped modes. Examine the full curve instead of assuming that agreement at two calibration points establishes consistent damping throughout the dynamic model. Assume target damping0.05 at1 and3Hz. C=αM+βK gives α=0.47124s⁻¹,β=0.0039789s; at2Hz the damping ratio is0.04375.

Reservoir pressure can couple with dam movement, while an added-mass approximation represents an equivalent effect only under stated geometry and frequency conditions. The entire reservoir mass cannot be attached to the dam, nor can compressibility, absorption and water-level change always be ignored. This unit holds stiffness fixed to isolate the period effect of one assumed modal addition. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation.

Joint opening comes from simultaneous relative displacement, not subtraction or quadrature of unrelated extrema. Coordinate direction and local normal must be defined so common rigid translation cancels. Contact, waterstop response and combined shear require additional models; a displacement difference alone does not establish watertightness or allowable joint performance during an earthquake. Assume simultaneous normal displacements u1=12mm and u2=−8mm. Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima.

A dynamic timestep must resolve relevant short periods, but points per cycle are only an initial check, not proof of convergence. Input sampling, interpolation, integration algorithm and nonlinear contact may impose stricter limits. Refinement should compare peaks, phase and energy rather than merely confirming that software completes without numerical divergence or reported errors. Assume the shortest relevant period0.20s and timestep0.005s. T/Δt=40points per cycle, without guaranteeing input bandwidth or resolved contact response.

Embankments can develop cyclic pore pressure and altered strength, mechanisms distinct from a linear concrete oscillator. Effective-stress reduction needs matching stress paths and times. A pore-pressure ratio alone cannot declare the entire dam liquefied; residual strength, post-earthquake drainage and permanent deformation still require appropriate material testing and stability analysis rather than transfer of concrete-dam assumptions. Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict.
evidence: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。
分欄記錄輸入點、反應點、單位及坐標方向，確認g已乘9.81m/s²。以同時刻的加速度與支承反力檢查動力平衡，並區分絕對和相對加速度，不拿不相干峰值作平衡驗算。
列出材料阻尼、邊界吸收和接觸摩擦的實作位置，檢查同一耗能是否重複計算。以自由衰減或頻率反應資料校核，另做阻尼敏感度，保存反應改變原因而非只報最小應力。
畫出多個頻率比的反應曲線，標明以靜態位移為分母的定義。再輸入短脈衝與有限週期正弦比較建立時間，檢查模型仍線性時兩種結果為何不同，不把穩態峰值直接當地震需求。
核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。用同一歷時振子直接求位移峰值對照，確認週期及阻尼一致，並保留多模態合成方法的另行說明。
evidenceEn: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement.

Record input and response locations, units and axes separately, converting g to9.81m/s². Check dynamic balance using simultaneous accelerations and support reactions and distinguish absolute from relative acceleration instead of combining unrelated individual peak values for equilibrium.

Map material damping, absorbing boundaries and contact friction to check duplicate dissipation. Compare free-decay or frequency-response evidence and perform damping sensitivity, explaining changed response rather than reporting only the smallest calculated stress from a favorable parameter choice.

Plot response over several frequency ratios and state that magnification is relative to static displacement. Compare a short pulse and finite-cycle sinusoid to show buildup time, explaining their differences within the linear model rather than directly using the steady peak as earthquake demand.

Identify pseudo-spectral versus absolute-acceleration input and show conversion from g and period to angular frequency. Compare with direct oscillator displacement from the same record at matching period and damping, documenting the separate method used for multiple-mode combination.
pitfalls: 模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。第一週期接近量測時，局部接縫、壩肩或高階反應仍可能沒有被描述。
同時採很大材料阻尼和強吸收邊界可能過度消能，掩蓋壩肩需求。把小振幅試驗阻尼直接外推到嚴重開裂狀態，也會忽略隨振幅改變的機制。
將Hz直接當rad/s會使位移差數十倍，不同阻尼譜混用又會改變需求。即使單模態位移正確，各模態峰值同號相加仍可能不代表任何真實時刻。
直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。僅因空庫與滿庫週期不同就判定結構劣化，會把正常流固互制當成損傷。
程式穩定仍可能有顯著相位誤差，粗步長也會漏掉短促接觸力。把稀疏輸入內插成密集資料看似解析度提高，實際卻沒有補回缺失的地震頻率內容。
pitfallsEn: Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness. A matching first period can still leave joints, abutments and higher-mode responses poorly represented.

Large material damping combined with strongly absorbing boundaries can remove excessive energy and hide abutment demand. Extending small-amplitude damping into severe cracking also overlooks mechanisms that change as deformation amplitude grows during shaking.

Using hertz as radians per second changes displacement by a large factor, and mixing damping definitions changes demand. Even correct individual modal displacements need not occur with equal signs at one actual instant.

Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks. Declaring deterioration solely from empty- versus full-reservoir period differences mistakes normal fluid-structure interaction for structural damage.

A stable computation can retain serious phase error and miss brief contact forces. Interpolating sparse input into many samples looks more resolved but does not restore earthquake frequencies absent from the original measured record.

related.title: 水庫抽泥疏浚
related.transfer: 可遷移「模態質量與週期」與「附加水質量與週期」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水庫抽泥疏浚的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Modal mass and period" and "Added water mass and period" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Reservoir dredging must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限；水庫抽泥疏浚則以串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries; Reservoir dredging centres on connecting bathymetry dry-solids mass slurry transport and return-water management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「模態質量與週期」與「測深網格與挖方」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水庫抽泥疏浚，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「沉澱面積與表面負荷」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Modal mass and period” and “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Reservoir dredging, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Settling area and surface loading", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.title: 水壩地震動力分析
history.text: 水壩耐震方法隨結構型式及材料機制而分化，不能以一套線性振子概括所有壩。胡佛壩官方歷史記錄一九三五年主壩混凝土澆置完成，西斯克壩則在一九六三至一九六七年建成分區土石結構，兩者在此只作材料與幾何比較。工兵團二〇〇三年手冊整理混凝土水工結構線彈性歷時分析，墾務局二〇一五年土石壩耐震章節另處理相關土壤行為。課程以可追溯出版紀錄說明方法範圍，不宣稱原創質量、剛度或孔壓值曾在這些工程量得，也不把古老工程完成年份視為現行耐震驗證。
history.textEn: Seismic methods differ with structural form and material mechanism; one linear oscillator cannot describe every dam. Hoover’s official history records completion of main-dam concrete in1935, while Sisk was built as a zoned embankment during1963–1967. They are used only for material and geometry comparison. The2003 USACE manual addresses linear-elastic time histories for concrete hydraulic structures, while Reclamation’s2015 embankment chapter addresses relevant soil behavior. Publication history defines scope, without presenting synthetic masses, stiffnesses or pore pressures as measurements at these landmarks or treating historical completion as current seismic verification.
